purpose: Avoid claiming adaptive allocation wins merely because fixed baselines omit a cost-matched two-frame option.
uniform_max: Select the highest global frame level with total real depth frames <= current batch budget; never consult scores or labels.
validation_fixed: Select the best validation-MAE global level within its validation cap; at test downgrade if necessary to largest feasible level no larger than chosen. No test labels used.
imputation: RBF kernel ridge predicts full depth descriptor from RGB; compare absolute resulting joint-score change to RGB; select hyperparameters by the same validation caps; this is an imputation-inspired comparator, not a reproduction of published diffusion systems.
matching: Use exactly the nine stored repeated-group base models/splits. Reuse existing level0/1/3/6/12 scorer fits; fit missing levels only on training and validate with the same fixed grid.
history: This control expansion follows the initial repeated-split experiment. Both earlier and expanded outcomes will be reported, not relabelled as one pre-registered trial.
